plan.txt.text:
Untimed opportunity diagnostic against qualified c942b254 production, before any candidate timing. No adoption claim. Goal remains <7000 ns per charged physics frame with unchanged tracks, exact physics, search and denominator.

FrameStates uses shared 64-state chunks and hides a truncated tail until append. Rc::make_mut currently clones the entire retained chunk before truncating to the visible prefix. Count shared append operations, states copied by the original operation, and states actually visible before append. This establishes whether copying only the visible prefix could avoid meaningful work. The original implementation remains in place in the instrumented diagnostic; counters do not change clone/truncation/push order. Check exact default track/work. No profiling, build or diagnostic runs alongside performance timing.

If counts show substantial avoidable copying, consider a separate small copy-on-write implementation: clone the visible prefix into one chunk-sized buffer only when shared; otherwise truncate and append in place. Preserve immutable chunk sharing, ABI, solver state, frame counts, and truncation semantics; do not add caching or tuning knobs. This is not the prior compact-frame representation trial: state representation and equations remain unchanged.
